name: doodad-snap-custom
description: Snap Doodads on Load for custom types whose pathing texture the map's object data names: 7 custom doodads (w3d dptx 2x2, 4x4, 6x6, 8x4, 12x4, 1x1 Default and _) and 4 custom destructables (w3b bptx 2x2, 4x4, 8x4, _), each placed off its grid at two angles (fixtures/we-specs/make-doodad-snap.mjs); the editor opens the map and saves it, Studio opens it in the terrain view and saves; the 18 doodads and destructables on their grids match in position, angle, scale and life; all 22 match since branch doodad-load-angles (2026-11-14): a destructable's fixed rotation holds only with a pathing texture, a square 1x1Default (2x2 picture, one magenta pixel) turns to the quarter

steps.eval: const s = await w3.services.get('w3.terrain'); for (let i = 0; i < 60 && !s.placedObjects()?.doodads?.length; i++) await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 500)); window.__driveEd.pushEdit({ undo() {}, redo() {}, terrain: false, objects: false });
